reply.usage: screenrec <operation> [--socket PATH] [--params JSON|-] [--id ID] [--output FILE|NEW_DIRECTORY] | screenrec mcp [--socket PATH]
reply.service: Without --socket, calls use $SCREENREC_HOME/run/service.sock (default ~/.screen-recorder) and launch the personal app once, within ten seconds, when nothing answers there. --socket connects to that path directly and never launches an app.
reply.timeUnits: Microseconds. Endpoints accept integers or exact reduced fractions where the operation's input schema permits them. Ranges are half-open in the selected anchor domain and expectedRevisionId.
reply.mutations: When the operation schema accepts requestId, supply a stable value and reuse it with identical arguments after an uncertain write. Supply expectedRevisionId only where its schema requires it.
